periods.description: Mysterious powerful creatures emerging from ruins, hostile to humans and animals, and requiring Drag-Rides to defeat reliably.
periods.principles: Abyss possess unusual bodies and abilities; destroying their core can eliminate them, but ordinary weapons are ineffective and contact can be lethal.
periods.classification: Gargoyle-type, slime-type large Abyss, and other undocumented types.
periods.origin: Appear from or around ruins; in volume 1 they are also manipulated by the flute.
limitations: can be controlled or hatched by the mysterious flute
